input_ports.I0: two valid nonnegative n-bit operands U and V

logical_functions.interface: Only the externally specified product semantics are universal; transform, layout and storage choices belong to the selected realization.
logical_functions.name: Produce the exact integer product

output_ports.OUT: exact UV in the requested output format

logical_functions.interface: Encoding and scale are explicit and must preserve recoverable numeric values. A radix or particular precision formula is a realization choice.
logical_functions.name: Accept and represent operands

output_ports.P0: preserved operands and admissible representation descriptors

logical_functions.purpose: Preserve operand values while making their representation usable.

logical_functions.interface: The selected system pads, reindexes and transforms; the logical function does not require CRT, Fourier transforms or a particular decomposition.
logical_functions.name: Make operands usable for product computation

output_ports.P1: valid inputs to the chosen product-computation interface

logical_functions.purpose: Provide the organization required by the chosen product method.

logical_functions.interface: The selected Fourier realization uses P2 matching-coordinate arrays internally. Different methods may satisfy the same goal with different internal ports.
logical_functions.name: Compute sufficient product information

output_ports.P3: information sufficient to recover the exact product

logical_functions.purpose: Establish the product relation in the internal representation.

input_ports.P3: internal product information plus validity/error guarantees

logical_functions.interface: If approximate arithmetic is used, recovery needs a sufficient exactness margin. The present two S factors, rounding and inverse CRT are conditional on this representation.
logical_functions.name: Recover exact result values

output_ports.E0: exact values sufficient for output encoding

logical_functions.purpose: Resolve internal scales or approximations into exact integer information.

logical_functions.interface: Frozen outer proof uses carries and exactly 2n output bits. An output-format change is possible only with a revised boundary contract.
logical_functions.name: Normalize and emit the result
logical_functions.purpose: Meet the requested external representation contract.

input_ports.LOC_IN: complete payload streams and logical owners

logical_functions.interface: Value identity, owner bijections, exact frame interpretation and movement cost must remain valid. The chosen address geometry is not universal.
logical_functions.name: Place data at required interfaces

output_ports.LOC_OUT: the same intended values at the requested owners/frames

logical_functions.purpose: Deliver corresponding values to the locations and representations consumed by an operation.

input_ports.MAP_IN: payload and exact requested operator contract

logical_functions.interface: F₂ payload, rational-address and exact-complex phase contracts are different operator domains and cannot be interchanged by matching rank alone.
logical_functions.name: Evaluate required component maps

output_ports.MAP_OUT: the requested output action at valid endpoint representations

logical_functions.purpose: Realize each caller-requested arithmetic or linear operator.

input_ports.WORK_IN: live values, declared dirty/clean workspace and ownership

logical_functions.interface: The number of banks, ownership schedule and dirty-versus-clean choice are architectural. Any replacement must preserve alias, lifetime and resource contracts.
logical_functions.name: Manage temporary and shared storage

output_ports.WORK_OUT: valid live values and legal work lifetimes

logical_functions.purpose: Give operations usable storage without undeclared interference.

logical_functions.interface: Restoration is required where the caller grants a loan. Payload restoration, temporary erasure and address-frame completion are separate conditions.
logical_functions.name: Restore borrowed state

output_ports.BORROWED_OUT: the specified restored state and completed frame effect

logical_functions.purpose: Prevent a subroutine from corrupting externally owned values or representations.

input_ports.CHILD_IN: an exact residual problem and allowed resources

logical_functions.interface: Recursion, stage count and fallback strategy are realization choices. The chosen proof requires valid proper children, finite leaves, paid exceptional work and composable boundaries.
logical_functions.name: Complete and compose subproblems

output_ports.CHILD_OUT: a completed result with required state returned

logical_functions.purpose: Close each delegated computation under its caller’s endpoint and cost contracts.

input_ports.EVIDENCE_IN: pinned sources, declared interfaces and reconstructed finite recipes

logical_functions.interface: This is an assurance function, not another runtime multiplication step. A passed finite check does not replace an inherited theorem.
logical_functions.name: Establish the evidence for system claims

output_ports.EVIDENCE_OUT: checked finite facts plus explicit remaining theorem dependencies

logical_functions.purpose: Separate executable finite checks from retained assumptions and justify stated bounds.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change any internal representation or algorithm while preserving the external product meaning; revise the external contract explicitly if input/output meaning changes.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Affected encoding, product relation, decoding, and cost dependencies.

requirement_definitions.rationale: This is the requested mathematical result.
requirement_definitions.statement: For every allowed input, output represents the exact integer product.
requirement_definitions.title: Exact integer product

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Retire or reassign owned state under a changed caller contract; restoration is required only where promised.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Affected caller observations, ownership, live versions, endpoints and storage bill.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Endpoint-only equality can hide corrupted intermediate users.
requirement_definitions.statement: Preserve caller-promised values and properties at every required observation.
requirement_definitions.title: Honor promised state and observations
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Full boundary and trace relation on arbitrary allowed state.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change machine model or compiler with an explicit translation or new theorem.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Cost model, lowering, routing, workspace and composed complexity claims.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Algebra alone is not a physical cost proof.
requirement_definitions.statement: Implement every operation and movement claimed in the stated model with legal resources.
requirement_definitions.title: Realizable execution in the declared model
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Frame, routing, workspace and lowering arguments.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Use exact arithmetic or another successful decoder; neither rounding nor fixed dyadic precision is universal.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Affected approximation propagation, normalization, widths, decoder and physical cost.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Local exact algebra does not bound accumulated numerical error.
requirement_definitions.statement: Prove every numerical approximation affecting the result is compatible with exact decoding.
requirement_definitions.title: Justified exact recovery

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: A correctness experiment need not improve an exponent; an implementation may stay within an unchanged envelope.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Only the changed costs and downstream claims that consume them.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Omitted costs and conflated evidence can reverse a comparison.
requirement_definitions.statement: Account for all resources relevant to the claimed result and bind evidence to exact sources and scope.
requirement_definitions.title: Complete support for the claimed cost
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Complete net inventory, recurrence, finite/outer argument and evidence binding.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change field, encoding, integer lift or address model with a new interface proof.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Semantics, primes, geometry and numerical bounds.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Equal notation across fields may denote different maps.
requirement_definitions.statement: Specify payload/address domains, sizes, legal inputs and inherited hypotheses.
requirement_definitions.title: Declared mathematical domains

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change private intermediate values or enlarge the closed interval.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Every newly enclosed consumer, observation and source version.

requirement_definitions.rationale: An unobserved intermediate coordinate need not be fixed.
requirement_definitions.statement: Specify endpoint and every required observation at semantic events.
requirement_definitions.title: Complete boundary and observations
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Full operator/trace relation; all-column check when linearity is proved.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Use different sharing/loan/retirement contracts accepted by affected callers.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Owners, aliasing, copy/erase, inverse dependencies and actual stock.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Forward last-use is not inverse restoration.
requirement_definitions.statement: Declare owners, live versions, dirty/old state, loans, retirement and copy/erase conditions in both directions.
requirement_definitions.title: Ownership and lifetimes

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Choose different legal bases, frame plateaus, factorizations or routes.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Actual projector identities, primes, cover/namespace, observers and paid movement.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Equal ranks or small address-matrix similarity are insufficient.
requirement_definitions.statement: Specify exact frames/labels and complete address action, spectators, inverse and simultaneous injectivity.
requirement_definitions.title: Physical representations and routes
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Exact projectors/charts, complete payload action and route proof.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Use a different lift or a tighter bound; old coefficients need not match.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Any downstream assumption exceeded by the new envelope.

requirement_definitions.rationale: A new representative may be valid but have different growth.
requirement_definitions.statement: Bound coefficients, signed growth, norms, errors and record widths consumed by callers.
requirement_definitions.title: Consumed numerical envelope
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Signed prefix bounds and full analytic error propagation.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change counts, width, replicas, stage count or recurrence type with complete new accounting.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Stock/lifetime compatibility, full profile, finite constants, fallback, leaf and outer consumers.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Lower call count is not equivalent to lower paid moment.
requirement_definitions.statement: Declare net child inventory, true stock, replicas, finite costs, fallback, shrink and normalization.
requirement_definitions.title: Complete paid resource interface
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Full ledger and applicable scalar/stateful recurrence.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Use a different proved schedule or different stage topology.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Observation/owner/route dependencies, joint endpoints and full schedule bill.

requirement_definitions.statement: When retaining the current global theorem, respect complete-cover phase barriers and dependencies.
requirement_definitions.title: Retained phase-major composition

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change to coupled completion or a new live helper.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Joint payload endpoint, ownership/lifetimes, complete routing and resulting recurrence.

requirement_definitions.rationale: Volume and ranks alone do not complete a bank.
requirement_definitions.statement: When using independent banks, actual routed block projectors are disjoint and sum to each required bank endpoint.
requirement_definitions.title: Independent completed bank realization
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Actual chart identities, census, injectivity, endpoint and reverse schedule.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Choose different bases, prime set or reduction.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Complete new prime coverage, good/bad dispatch and fallback.

requirement_definitions.statement: For the rational-chart reduction, every consumed inverse/scaling exists at each eligible prime/ring.
requirement_definitions.title: Eligible chart arithmetic
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Cleared Gram and denominator factors; unit checks.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change representation, normalization or decoder with a complete alternative recovery proof.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: Affected error, scales, layout, widths, carry and finite costs.

requirement_definitions.rationale: The decoder's input assumptions must be established.
requirement_definitions.statement: For this recovery, restore both normalizations and coefficient order and achieve pre-rounding error below one half.
requirement_definitions.title: Retained approximate convolution recovery
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Exact scaling/width equations, inverse layout, nearest-integer and carry proofs.

overconstraint_audit.escape_route: Change bootstrap depth, balanced family or outer reduction.
overconstraint_audit.reopened_obligations: The replacement recurrence/leaf bridge and all affected analytic inequalities.

requirement_definitions.rationale: A limiting coarse rate is not a completed leaf.
requirement_definitions.statement: For this bound, use attained ordinary savings and valid bridge data in the selected outer inequalities.
requirement_definitions.title: Selected ordinary-leaf and outer assembly
requirement_definitions.verification_method: Three levels, 47 strict constraints and seven margins in current source.
